name: @gayatama/scoring
description: Pure, dependency-free scoring engine. Shared by the web app and the API so both produce identical numbers.

scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run mark-cjs && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p tsconfig.cjs.json
scripts.mark-cjs: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'); fs.mkdirSync('dist/cjs', { recursive: true }); fs.writeFileSync('dist/cjs/package.json', JSON.stringify({ type: 'commonjs' }))"
scripts.dev: npm run mark-cjs && concurrently --raw "tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "tsc -p tsconfig.cjs.json --watch --preserveWatchOutput"
